proposed_widenings.name: substitute_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The item changes the damage type of a weapon hit from its normal type to Lightning without replacing the hit or adding extra damage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: return_thrown_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The activated bolt property returns the same thrown weapon to the wielder's hand immediately after resolving damage, which is not expressible as destruction, dismissal, or existing transport.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: The once-per-dawn Lightning Bolt activation mostly matches the existing magic-item activation family, but the item's baseline damage-type substitution is a core mechanical rider with no current atom. Per protocol, I did not keep a partial authored unit that omits that rule.
